With reference to the attached cutting that appeared in
the columns of the North- China Daily News of May 24, 1940,
Mr. R. T. Peyton-Griffin, editor of this paper, declines

office.

anonymous communication addressed to me and received at

shed any light as to the identity of the writer.

Jewish Refugees:
Difficult to Reach Shanghai
To the Editor of the
"NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS"
SIR,—Relatives of European Jewish
refugees can travel via Siberia to
Shanghai, if the Entry Permit is
issued by the Japanese authorities,
e.g. in such a case the Consulate of
Manchoukuo will grant the necessary
visa.
To obtain an entry permit for
Hongkew is more or less impossible
—my own application for my wife
and my boy has been filed since
November 1939, without myself hav-
ing received the slightest notification
as to its possible success—whilst the
S.M.C. issues permits on a more
lenient scale, with the regrettable
drawback however, that the validity
for same is for four months only
and a prolongation rather difficult
to obtain.
A short while ago the fact was
published that with an entry permit
of the S.M.C. it would be possible
to travel via Siberia as well, as
arrangements have been made be-
tween the Daljew Hicem and the
respective governments, so that also
those relatives, who are in possession
of an S.M.C. permit could travel via
Siberia and Manchoukuo.
Since May 19, cables are arriving
from Europe, however, that this
possibility is void again and that,
unless the Japanese legalization is
granted, the permits of the Munici-
pality are of no use at all or one
must be in the position to pay
US$300 approximately for the voyage
to Shanghai by a steamer of the
Lloyd Triestino. In such a case no
legalization by the Japanese is re-
quired.
The experiences we Jewish Re-
fugees had in Nazi Germany are
well-known and I do appreciate it
enormously that shelter has been
given to us. But why, for heavens
sake, is it made so difficult for even
our nearest relations to join us? Why
is a way opened today and closed
again after a short while? Is this a
new game, being tried on us? How
long can our nerves stand such
teasing? Where is the possibility to
overcome this difficulty and who can
help me to get my family out of
Germany, before the Nazis have
starved them to death?
ONE PERSONALLY CONCERNED.
Shanghai, May 22.

（批：DS Plcs / 24 / '5）

犹太难民：
难以抵达上海
致《字林西报》编辑：

先生，——如果获得日本当局签发的入境许可证，欧洲犹太难民的亲属可以通过西伯利亚前往上海，例如在这种情况下，满洲国领事馆将签发必要的签证。

要获得虹口的入境许可证几乎是不可能的——我自1939年11月以来就为我的妻子和儿子提交了申请，但至今未收到任何关于申请可能成功的通知——而工部局（S.M.C.）签发许可证的条件较为宽松，但遗憾的是，其有效期仅为四个月，且延期相当困难。

不久前有消息公布称，持工部局的入境许可证也可以通过西伯利亚旅行，因为 Daljew Hicem（音译）与相关政府之间已达成协议，因此持有工部局许可证的亲属也可以通过西伯利亚和满洲国旅行。

然而，自5月19日以来，来自欧洲的电报称，这种可能性再次失效，除非获得日本的认证，否则工部局的许可证毫无用处，或者必须有能力支付约300美元，乘坐意大利劳埃德三隅公司（Lloyd Triestino）的轮船前往上海。在这种情况下，不需要日本的认证。

我们犹太难民在纳粹德国的经历众所周知，我非常感激给予我们的庇护。但是，天哪，为什么连我们要至亲来团聚都如此困难？为什么今天打开一条路，不久后又关闭？这是在对我们玩弄新花样吗？我们的神经还能忍受这种折磨多久？有什么办法可以克服这一困难，谁能在纳粹把我的家人饿死之前帮助我把他们带出德国？

一名切身利益相关者。
上海，5月22日。

（批注：DS Plcs / 24 / '5）

page_data.en:
Dear Sir,-
Please to read this advertisement and think about it!
The saddest joke ever seen is Your attitude in the case of permits,
where is the so called" gentleman-behaviour" of the British?
Fixing the running time of agranted permit on 4 month You know very
well that the unfortunate possessor of such a permit cant leave his
country on visa difficulties. Why the French Police is granting
permits without any timelimit??? Now the British Empire is in a
terrific war and all our wishes are the same like Yours to destroy this
bloody Nazi gouvernement, to build up again freedom and humanity!
But on You, Sir, it isnt quite clear, what You are calling humanity?
Give the permits like the French Police without timelimit or in
reasonable terms or stop it finally!
But how You are dealing in granting and refusing with the exact
knowledge what happens to these peoples that is only double-cross!
Think it ower:in Europe a british Refugee need somethik similar
and has to deal with a attitude like Yours!!
If You can please to enjoy Yourself on thet idea!

Another Refugee,
beeing father from a family,
still living in Nazi- Germany!
page_data.zh:
亲爱的先生，——
请阅读这则广告并思考一下！
最可悲的笑话莫过于你们在许可证问题上的态度，英国人所谓的“绅士风度”在哪里？
你们明知不幸的许可证持有人因签证困难无法离开本国，却将已签发许可证的有效期定为4个月。为什么法国警察签发没有任何期限限制的许可证？？？现在大英帝国正处于一场可怕的战争中，我们所有的愿望都与你们一样，即摧毁这个血腥的纳粹政府，重建自由与人道！
但是，先生，你们所称的人道究竟为何物，并不清楚。
像法国警察那样签发无期限限制的许可证，或者以合理的条款签发，或者干脆彻底停止签发！
但是，你们在明知这些人会遭遇何种境况的情况下，依然进行签发和拒签，这简直是双重背叛！
想一想吧：在欧洲，一位英国难民也需要类似的东西，并且不得不面对像你们这样的态度！！
如果你们能从这个想法中获得乐趣，那就请便吧！

另一位难民，
一个家庭的父亲，
仍居住在纳粹德国！

Subject Central European Refugees.

Made by and Forwarded by D.I. M. Umemoto

（批：C. P.）
（批：D.C. ( )）
（批：Forwarded）
（批：Nakagawa）
（印：D.C. (J.A.B.) / Deputy Commissioner (J.A.B.) / 30 MAY 1940 / POLICE）

（批：DC (Sp/3w)）
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE / 31 MAY 1940）

（批：+ / 1/2）

In connection with the attached report concerning a visit paid by D.P.S. Yonezawa of this office to Mr. Kann on May 24, 1940, D.P.S. Yonezawa states that, having been requested by the Japanese Gendarmerie Headquarters to verify a report published in the local Chinese newspapers to the effect that 3,000 Jewish refugees were coming to Shanghai shortly, without thinking any trouble would arise out of his visit he called at the office of the Committee for the Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, Embankment Building.

Here he was told by a foreigner that Mr. Kann would be able to give such information and was given a letter of introduction addressed to Mr. Kann.

Mr. Kann was interviewed during the afternoon of that date and it was learned from him that the report was incorrect.

As D.P.S. Yonezawa's visit was simply for the purpose of verifying the report published in the newspapers he did not forward any report on the subject.

Attention of the staff of this office will be called that in future whenever a request is made by the Japanese Authorities assistance should be given with the approval of the D.C. (J.A.B.).

（签名：Umemoto / D. I.）

D. C. (J.A.B.).

（批注：+ / 1/2）

关于本部门 D.P.S. Yonezawa 于1940年5月24日拜访 Kann 先生的附件报告，D.P.S. Yonezawa 陈述称，受日本宪兵队总部请求，核实当地中文报纸上刊登的一则报道，该报道称将有3000名犹太难民即将来到上海。他认为此次拜访不会引起任何麻烦，于是前往位于外滩大楼的“上海欧洲犹太难民援助委员会”办公室。

在那里，一名外国人告诉他，Kann 先生能够提供此类信息，并给了他一封写给 Kann 先生的介绍信。

当天下午他采访了 Kann 先生，并从他那里得知该报道不实。

由于 D.P.S. Yonezawa 的拜访仅仅是为了核实报纸上刊登的报道，他并未就此主题提交任何报告。

提请本部门职员注意，今后凡日本当局提出请求，应在日籍事务部副督察长（D.C. (J.A.B.)）批准下提供协助。

（签名：Umemoto / 副督察）

副督察长（日籍事务部）。

During a visit paid to this office by
Mr. E. Kann during the afternoon of May 24 for
the purpose of exchanging information on refugee
matters, Mr. Kann stated that D.S. Yonezawa of
the Special Political office of the Police had
visited him at 2.40 p.m. May 24 for the purpose
of securing certain statistics and information
relating to the local Jewish refugee problem.
Mr. Kann was under the impression that the
detective was attached to the Special Branch
and assisted him as much as possible and then
referred him to the I.C. Committee (Komor) for
further details.
In view of the fact that the Special
Branch has an office solely dealing with Jewish
refugee matters, it is respectfully suggested
that if it is essential for the Special Political
office to gather information relating to refugees,
matters would be considerably facilitated by
application to the D.C. (Special Branch).

DC (J.A.B.)
Please see Mr Yorkes dont
overlap. Why are you
D.O. (Special Branch)
interested in Jew Refugees?
May I see a copy of K
report D.S. Yonezawa has
prepared & call you to me
know why he was put on his work.

Jo. Pierce.

E. Kann 先生于5月24日下午来访本部门，目的是交换有关难民事宜的信息。Kann 先生表示，警务处特别政治股的 D.S. Yonezawa 于5月24日下午2点40分拜访了他，目的是获取有关本地犹太难民问题的某些统计数据和信息。
Kann 先生以为该侦探隶属于特别课，因此尽可能提供了协助，随后将他引荐给国际委员会（Komor）以获取更多细节。

鉴于特别课设有专门处理犹太难民事宜的办公室，谨建议，如果特别政治股确有必要收集有关难民的信息，若向特别课副督察长提出申请，事务处理将会大大便利。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 54226
Section 1, Special Branch Scottish 39
REPORT
Date August 9, 19 39.

Subject. Central European Jews - applicants congregating on the sixth floor.

Made by....................and....................Forwarded by D. I. Crawford.

With a view to regulating the stream of Central
European Jews attending daily at the six floor to
see D.S. Pitts and the continual difficulty of
explanation when the officer is not there, enquiries
were made by the undersigned from P. A. to D.C.(Crime)
regarding the use of the Lecture Room on the 2nd
floor, twice weekly, where there would be no reason
for congestion in the corridor and minimum of
inconvenience to other members of the staff. The
P.A. to D.C. (Crime) was agreeable to this suggestion
and D.S. Pitts has arranged with Mr. Komor of the
I. C. Relief Fund to issue a notice for exhibition
at his office notifying those people that Room 207,
Police Headquarters, will be used from 9 a.m. to
noon on Tuesdays and Fridays ONLY for their reception.
A rough draft of the notice that it is proposed
to place in a prominent position on the ground floor
of Police Headquarters is attached hereto.
D.S. Pitts will interview all refugees until
he proceeds on short leave on August 16, when, it
is suggested, D.S.I. Wittinsky take over this work,
the Boarding House Section being situated next to
the Lecture Room.

O.K.
J.P.
E.I. hoffo
9/8
D.C.R.
9/8

C. Crawford
D. I.

D.C. (Special Branch)

事由：中欧犹太人——聚集在六楼的申请人。

制作人....................及....................转呈人 D. I. Crawford。

为了规范每天到六楼找 D.S. Pitts 的中欧犹太人流，以及当警官不在时解释工作带来的持续困难，下文签署人向犯罪部副督察长的私人助理（P. A. to D.C.(Crime)）查询了关于每周两次使用二楼演讲室的可行性，这样走廊就不会拥挤，对其他职员的干扰也最小。犯罪部副督察长的私人助理同意这一建议，D.S. Pitts 已与国际救济基金（I. C. Relief Fund）的 Komor 先生安排，在其办公室发布通知，告知相关人员，警察总局207室仅在周二和周五上午9点至中午用于接待他们。
拟张贴在警察总局一楼显眼位置的通知草稿附后。
D.S. Pitts 将面试所有难民，直到他于8月16日开始短期休假，届时建议由 D.S.I. Wittinsky 接管此项工作，因为寄宿管理处就在演讲室旁边。

同意。
J.P.
E.I. hoffo
8月9日
D.C.R.
8月9日

C. Crawford
副督察

副督察长（特别课）
